comment: Source is not published, and neither the README nor the repository has a KordZ manual at tag v2.6.13. The chord names come from KordZModule::SearchChordInDictionnary, whose literals run Unison, Octave, Minor, Major, Diminished, Augmented, Suspended 4, Maj(b5) and Chord? for anything it cannot name. The idle text Need PITCH... and Need GATE... and the voice-count text Monophonic and -voice poly. are set in process and DisplayIdleMessage. The module's menu is Model, Notation and a greyed License: full version (for everyone) label; Model is the plugin-wide theme submenu and gets no line.
